title: Dragon Ring Seal
description: A highly detailed dark metallic ring shaped like a wax seal featuring a coiled dragon emblem at its center. The ring has a cracked black surface with gold inlays, engraved text on the band, and dripping colorful wax effects against a dark background.
prompt: Highly detailed dark metallic ring designed as a wax seal with a coiled dragon holding a skull at the center, cracked black surface with gold inlays and hour markers, engraved text on the band reading GLORY and something reversed, colorful dripping wax in purple and red, dramatic lighting on dark background, intricate fantasy object art
